PROJECT SPECFIC NOTES QUANTITY ESTIMATE
1. ALL CONCRETE SLABS PROPOSED TO BE RETAINED AND/OR REPLACED ARE TO BE SAW CUT AT MIDSPAN.
2. ALL PROPOSED CONCRETE SLABS SHALL BE REINFORCED TO THE ADJACENT SLAB.
3. ALL EXISTING MINOR CRACKS IN SLABS TO BE RETAINED SHALL BE SEALED IN ACCORDANCE TO GDOT DETAIL 5046H.
4. CONTRACTOR SHALL MATCH ALL EXISTING PROFILES AMD CROSS SLOPES.
5. CONTRACTOR SHALL MATCH ALL EXISTING PAVEMENT MARKING.
6. CONTRACTOR MAY SUBMIT AND RECEIVE APPROVAL FOR AN ALTERNATE TRAFFIC CONTROL PLAN THAT INCLUDES THE DETOUR AROUND MEAD RD FROM THE
MACON-BIBB COUNTY ENGINEER AND GDOT.
7. ALL TRAFFIC CONTROL MEASURES MUST BE INSTALLED AND APPROVED BEFORE ANY WORK CAN BE STARTED.
8. PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION, THE CONTRACTOR SHALL SUBMIT A "RIGHT-OF-WAY EXCAVATION / OCCUPATION APPLICATION & PERMIT" TO THE
MACON-BIBB ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT. THE APPLICATION WILL INCLUDE THE CONTRACTOR'S PROPOSED TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PLAN.
